name: atlassian
description: Atlassian Rovo MCP: Jira, Confluence, Compass. Search, summarize, create/update issues and pages. Remote server, OAuth 2.1.
notes: Add to .cursor/mcp.json.source: "atlassian": { "url": "https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp" }. Run python3 .scripts/cursor-sync-mcp.py and restart Cursor. For multiple Confluence sites add a second entry (e.g. atlassian-connellsgroup) with same URL; authorize each entry separately (OAuth per site). Use for Confluence: read Spaces, create new pages. Not yet wired into PRD-push flow.
